code: const BASE_URL='/api/products';export const getProducts=async()=>{const res=await fetch(BASE_URL);if(!res.ok){throw new Error("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0437\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043A\u0438: ".concat(res.status));}return res.json();};export const deleteProduct=async id=>{const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/").concat(id),{method:'DELETE'});if(res.status===204||res.ok){return true;}throw new Error("\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043D\u0435 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C: ".concat(res.status));};
